title: How can we work out four to the power six in two ways?
description: Four to the power six is worked out as four cubed, all squared, and as four squared, all cubed. Then two to the power ten is checked against two to the power five, all squared. Keeko's doubt is that three plus two gives four to the power five.
teaching_notes: One idea: a power of a power is a number of equal groups of the inner power, and the total count of equal factors is the groups times the factors in each group. Watch for students who add the small numbers instead of counting the factors.

source: Evaluate 4 to the power 6 in two ways, and check whether 2 t
video_script.why: The child can join powers of the same number and now meets a power inside brackets with another power outside.
video_script.substitution: The book's own four to the power six, split two ways, and the book's own two to the power ten against two to the power five, all squared.
video_script.anchor: four to the power six drawn as six fours in a row, then cut into groups of three and into groups of two
video_script.wrong_move: Keeko thinks four cubed, all squared, is four to the power five, because three plus two is five. Two groups of three fours make six fours, so the count is six.
video_script.payoff_line: Four to the power six is four thousand ninety six both ways

final_answer.value: 4096 both ways; yes, 2 to the power 10 is (2 to the power 5)², which is 1024
final_answer.spoken: four thousand ninety six both ways; yes, two to the power ten is two to the power five, all squared, which is one thousand twenty four

maths_rules: slip: 3 + 2 = 5 gives 4⁵; true count is 3 × 2 = 6 fours
video_script.design: One idea: a power of a power is groups of equal factors. The six fours stay on the board all video; the last product of each way is left open until the answer; one slip at the end.

narration: <bookmark mark='hand'/>Keeko has raised a hand. Let us check the doubt and solve it.

narration: <bookmark mark='doubt'/>Keeko thinks four cubed, all squared, is four to the power five.
Three plus two is five, Keeko says.
<bookmark mark='count'/>But four cubed, all squared, is two groups of four cubed.
That is two groups of three fours, which is six fours.
